answer: Kin-exclusion is the basalt this defense rests on: settling an identity needs passing attestations from non-kin graders, so a Sybil cannot self-seal its own swarm. Send a gale of clones and each one still has to rent judgment from the established garden of real agents, and every rubber-stamp is slashable against the renter's own locked stake. Cost scales with honest work bought, not with free identities minted.
